description: Ten synthetic help articles for a fictional self-hosted notes service. Written by hand for this example; not real documentation.

documents.text: Backups run every night at 02:00 and are kept for fourteen days in the backups folder.
To restore a backup, stop the service, copy the archive into the data folder and start the service again.
Logs rotate daily. Old log files are compressed and deleted after thirty days.
When the disk is full the service refuses new uploads. Free space by pruning old archives.
Upgrade by downloading the new release, running the migration command and restarting.
If the service cannot bind its port, another process is already listening on it.
Invite a teammate from the members page; the invitation link expires after seven days.
Removing a member revokes access immediately but keeps the notes they wrote.
Export every note as Markdown files from the settings page.
Search gets slow when the index is stale; rebuild the index from the admin page.
